metadata.title: Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome-based streams of a specialty retailer on Vendit: sell at the counter, keep stock right, connect suppliers, sell online and on marketplaces, ship and return, repair, order and invoice, loyalty, steering, multi-store formulas and going live.
metadata.flowModelNote: Each step names the bricks it depends on; personas are documented in customers.json JTBD steps.
